cover.desc: Full color, but nearly all of it is the yellow-white of a single bare bulb against cold blue-black shadow. The boiler room of Kotobuki-yu at four in the morning, shot from low and wide so the machine dominates the frame: old lagged pipes, a brass valve wheel, the pressure gauge, the wrench hanging on its nail beside the worn mark in the paint. Itsuki is on his knees at the valve in his green-trimmed school jersey, sleeves shoved back, both hands on the wheel, head turned to look back over his shoulder — filthy, exhausted, fully awake. Nagi sits on an upturned crate in the doorway at the top of the steps, out of the light, hair down out of its clip, a blanket round her shoulders and a battered hardback exercise book open flat across her knees, one finger holding a place on the page. She is not touching the machine. She is reading him a number. The composition is a triangle: her, the book, his hands. No tears anywhere in the image.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: stopping in the doorway, taking it in
chars.pose: one shoe off, bag still on his shoulder

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu changing room at 11:52pm. The lamp is on and everything else is wrong: no steam through the bath doorway, no condensation on the glass, the air visibly cold, baskets already stacked hours early.
panels.action: The building is the wrong temperature. You can see that from the door.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: fingers in the bath water up to the second knuckle

panels.bg: the surface of the bath, dead flat, no steam, the tiled bottom visible right through it
panels.action: Cold. Not cooling. Cold.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: straightening up fast
chars.pose: wiping his hand on his jersey, already turning toward the boiler stairs

panels.bg: bath hall, cold, the far door open onto the boiler steps, a bare bulb burning down there
panels.action: There is a light on downstairs that should not still be on at midnight.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — crouched with her back to the steps
chars.pose: wedged in beside the boiler with a spanner, sleeves soaked to the shoulder, hair coming out of the clip

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, pipes, a spread of tools on a towel on the floor, three empty bottles of water, the exercise book shut on the shelf
panels.action: The floor around her has the specific mess of somebody who has been solving one problem for a very long time.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: already at the bottom of the steps
chars.pose: bag dumped, sleeves going up

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, steps behind him
panels.action: He does not come down. He is already down.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: grey, eyes red-rimmed with tiredness, entirely level
chars.pose: not turning round, spanner still on the nut

panels.bg: boiler casing, bare bulb, hard shadows
panels.action: It is Thursday. She answers in one word and does not think it is worth more than that.

panels.bg: a phone face-up on the boiler-room shelf beside the exercise book, screen lit
panels.action: The only reason he is allowed to still be here at midnight.

dialogue.text: Mom's off tonight. Sōta's down. Go if you're going.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, pointing with the spanner without looking
chars.pose: indicating a valve on the return line

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: following the point
chars.pose: crouching at the pipe

panels.bg: boiler room, lagged pipes, bare bulb
panels.action: She does not explain the machine. She has never once explained the machine. She points at things in the order they need doing.

dialogue.text: Both hands. Quarter turn. Then stop.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: concentrating, listening to the pipe
chars.pose: hands on the valve wheel, head tilted toward the metal

panels.bg: the valve, lagged pipe, bare bulb
panels.action: Air comes out of the line in a long ugly rattle.

dialogue.text: Is it supposed to make that noise?

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: focused, something almost like hope in the set of her shoulders
chars.pose: crouched at the burner, hand on the ignition

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: watching the gauge for her
chars.pose: one hand braced on the casing

panels.bg: boiler room, burner housing, the gauge, bare bulb
panels.action: 1:40am. It catches.

panels.bg: the pressure gauge, needle lifting off the pin and climbing steadily into the low band
panels.action: It climbs. For about ninety seconds, it is fine.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — head down, both hands flat on the boiler casing
chars.pose: kneeling in front of the dead machine

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: hand still up by the gauge, not moving
chars.pose: frozen

panels.bg: boiler room plunged back to just the bare bulb, the burner window gone dark, the needle back on its pin
panels.action: The safety trips. Everything stops.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: already reaching for the spanner again
chars.pose: shifting round to the return line

panels.bg: boiler room, tools on the towel, bare bulb
panels.action: She does not say anything about it. She starts again from the beginning.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mild, careful
chars.pose: sitting back on his heels

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: working
chars.pose: spanner on the nut

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, the fish clock not visible from down here

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: asking the question anyway
chars.pose: not moving to help, watching her

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: no reaction at all, spanner turning
chars.pose: working

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, hard shadow
panels.action: She does not answer this one, which is the answer.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only, fine tremor in it
chars.pose: fingers failing to close on a spanner handle; the spanner turning out of her grip

panels.bg: wet concrete floor, tools, bare bulb
panels.action: Her hands are never wrong.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: picking it up on the second attempt, unbothered
chars.pose: reaching down

panels.bg: boiler-room floor, bare bulb
panels.action: She picks it up on the second try and does not appear to have noticed there was a first.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: flat, no joke anywhere near it
chars.pose: standing now

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking up
chars.pose: back at the nut

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb
panels.action: Two words each.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: ordinary, mid-task
chars.pose: straightening up off the boiler, one hand on the pipe above her, the other braced on her knee

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, pipes
panels.action: She stands up to reach the upper valve. That is all that happens.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes unfocused, pupils wide, nothing behind them for about a second
chars.pose: head up, not seeing

panels.bg: hard black screentone closing in from every edge of the panel until only a narrow ring of the room is left. Standard grey-out convention.
panels.action: One second.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: down, awkward, one arm folded under her, hair across her face
chars.pose: collapsed on the wet concrete, legs not arranged, entirely graceless

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mid-turn, face wiped blank
chars.pose: two metres away, already coming

panels.bg: boiler-room floor, tools scattered, the spanner skidding away across the concrete, bare bulb overhead
panels.action: She goes down hard and she goes down ugly. Nothing about it is beautiful.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: hand on her shoulder, voice arriving before anything else
chars.pose: on his knees on the concrete

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes open, already pushing at the floor
chars.pose: trying to get an elbow under herself

panels.bg: boiler-room floor, bare bulb, hard shadow
panels.action: She is conscious. She is embarrassed. That is the first thing she is.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: the arm giving out from under her
chars.pose: elbow folding, going back down onto the concrete

panels.bg: wet floor, bare bulb, close
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: completely level, the flat calm voice he uses at two in the morning on a six-year-old
chars.pose: getting her arm up over his shoulder, one hand spread on her back

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes half shut, not helping, not resisting
chars.pose: dead weight

panels.bg: boiler-room floor, steps beyond, bare bulb
panels.action: He does not ask permission and he does not make a speech. He has done this a hundred times, just never with somebody this size.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: teeth set, straining, having to reset his grip halfway up
chars.pose: carrying her up the narrow boiler steps, one arm under her knees, her head against his collarbone, both of them at a bad angle

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes shut, face turned in
chars.pose: carried, one hand hanging

panels.bg: the narrow boiler stairs, bare bulb below, cold changing-room light above. Her heel catches the door frame on the way through.
panels.action: It is awkward, it is heavy, and it takes him two goes. He apologises to her foot.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: breathing hard, concentrating on the landing
chars.pose: lowering her onto the tatami bench, hand behind her head until it is down

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes shut
chars.pose: going down onto the bench

panels.bg: rest area, tatami bench, warm lamp, the massage chair humming in the corner, fish clock on the wall
panels.action: He puts a hand behind her head so it does not hit the wood. Nobody in the room registers that he did that.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: no expression to speak of, moving
chars.pose: at the cold case, taking out a bottle of milk

panels.bg: the humming cold case, warm lamp, rest area beyond
panels.action: He does the one thing this building does for tired people.

panels.bg: the tatami bench beside her hand: a bottle of milk standing upright on the mat, about twenty centimetres from her fingers. Untouched. Nobody is holding it out.
panels.action: He sets it down within reach and does not hand it to her. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes open now, looking at the ceiling, not moving
chars.pose: flat on the tatami bench, one arm across her stomach

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not looking at her
chars.pose: sitting on the floor with his back against the massage chair, a metre away, knees up

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, the fish clock, the milk bottle standing on the mat between them
panels.action: He sits on the floor. He does not sit on the bench. The distance is exact.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: awake, blank
chars.pose: on her back

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: head back against the vinyl, eyes on nothing
chars.pose: sitting

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, steam absent, the building cold around them
panels.action: Neither of them says anything for a long time. Silent.

panels.bg: the fish-shaped clock on the wall of the rest area, reading 3:14
panels.action: The clock says 3:14.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — face turned away toward the wall
chars.pose: flat on the bench

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — head down
chars.pose: on the floor against the chair

panels.bg: rest area, wide, warm lamp, the whole cold building around two people and one bottle of milk
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not looking at her, asking it the way you'd ask the time
chars.pose: sitting on the floor, forearms on his knees

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, the bench edge just in frame
panels.action: Four words. Nothing before them and nothing after them.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes open, fixed on the ceiling, absolutely nothing happening on her face
chars.pose: still flat on the bench

panels.bg: ceiling boards above the bench, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Nobody has asked her that in fourteen months. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible
chars.pose: on the bench

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible
chars.pose: on the floor

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, the fish clock reading 3:17
panels.action: Three minutes go past. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, quiet, entirely matter-of-fact — she is not making a point
chars.pose: still looking at the ceiling

panels.bg: close on her, warm lamp, flat screentone, the ceiling out of focus
panels.action: She does not answer the question he asked. She answers the one nobody has asked. Nothing in this chapter explains this line and nothing in the series ever will.

dialogue.text: If I stop, it's just a building.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — back turned
chars.pose: standing, reaching behind the massage chair

panels.bg: the massage chair, the switch on its side panel, warm lamp
panels.action: He does not answer her. He gets up and turns off the only thing in the room making a noise.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: one hand gripping the wooden edge of the bench, knuckles white over the split skin

panels.bg: bench edge, tatami, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: The room goes quiet and she stops being able to hold it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible at all — turned into the wall, hair fallen forward, one forearm across her face
chars.pose: curled on her side on the bench, shoulders going

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — back to her, sitting down again on the floor
chars.pose: lowering himself back to the same spot, facing away

panels.bg: rest area from across the room, warm lamp, the silent chair, the milk still standing untouched on the mat
panels.action: The camera stays where it is. He does not go to her and he does not touch her. He sits back down facing the other way.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: eyes open, jaw tight, doing the single hardest thing he has ever done, which is nothing
chars.pose: sitting against the dead chair, hands loose between his knees

panels.bg: rest area floor, warm lamp, the bench behind him out of focus
panels.action: He is very good at making a room easier. He does not do it. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible
chars.pose: curled on the bench, quieter now

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible
chars.pose: on the floor, facing away

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, fish clock reading 3:51, the cold building, two people three feet apart and not touching
panels.action: Thirty-four minutes. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: swollen-eyed, businesslike, absolutely not discussing it
chars.pose: sitting up on the bench, wiping her face on her sleeve in one pass

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, fish clock at 3:55
panels.action: She sits up. Nothing that happened is going to be mentioned by anybody, now or later.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, already working the problem
chars.pose: reaching for the milk at last, unscrewing it

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: turning round where he sits
chars.pose: on the floor

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp
panels.action: Two hours and five minutes.

dialogue.text: It has to be on by six.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: getting her feet under her and finding they still do not work properly
chars.pose: half up off the bench, one hand out to the wall

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: already there, not touching her, hand hovering
chars.pose: standing close

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, bench
panels.action: She cannot stand for two hours. Both of them arrive at that fact at the same time.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, pointing with the milk bottle
chars.pose: sat back down on the bench

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: waiting for the instruction
chars.pose: standing

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, the dark bath doorway beyond
panels.action: She has never let anyone else touch that machine with intent. She takes about four seconds over it.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: coming back up the steps with it, holding it flat in both hands
chars.pose: the cracked hardback exercise book

panels.bg: boiler steps, bare bulb below, warm lamp above
panels.action: He knows exactly where it lives. He put it back there himself, once, badly.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: book open on her knees, thumbing back through the block of pages
chars.pose: on an upturned crate now, blanket round her shoulders, at the top of the boiler steps

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not following
chars.pose: crouched below her on the steps

panels.bg: the top of the boiler steps, bare bulb below, warm lamp above, the book open across her knees
panels.action: Two words. Then two more, when he does not get it.

panels.bg: an open page of the logbook, dated in the small neat slanted hand. Unlike every other page, this one is not one line a day — it is a dense column of readings twenty minutes apart, running from before four in the morning until past six: time, temperature, time, temperature, all the way down. A cold start, recorded in full, on the second of January.
panels.action: He shut it down every New Year's Day and lit it again on the second, and every single time he wrote down what the machine did.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: understanding what he is looking at
chars.pose: head over the page, hand flat on the step

panels.bg: the open book, bare bulb light from below, warm light from above
panels.action: The man did not leave instructions. He left evidence. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: practical, keeping it to a question about quantity
chars.pose: looking up at her

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, turning a page
chars.pose: book on her knees

panels.bg: boiler steps, book, bare bulb
panels.action: He asks the smallest possible version of the question.

dialogue.text: How many of these are there?

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes on the page, unchanged
chars.pose: finger holding a place

panels.bg: the open book, close, bare bulb
panels.action: One word. She is seventeen.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: sleeves back, both hands on the valve wheel, entirely serious
chars.pose: kneeling at the boiler

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: on the crate in the doorway above, book open, one finger on a line
chars.pose: not touching anything

panels.bg: boiler room from low and wide, bare bulb, pipes, the gauge, her small and lit from behind in the doorway at the top of the steps
panels.action: 4:11am. For the first time since he died, somebody else has their hands on this machine, and she is letting them.

dialogue.text: Eighth of a turn. Then wait.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: concentrating, one hand on the ignition
chars.pose: crouched at the burner

panels.bg: burner housing, the window lighting up orange, bare bulb
panels.action: It catches. Nobody celebrates.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes on the page, reading out a number a dead man wrote
chars.pose: book flat on her knees

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: eyes on the dial, calling his own back
chars.pose: at the gauge with a pencil and an old receipt

panels.bg: boiler room, the gauge, bare bulb, her in the doorway above
panels.action: This is how the rest of the night goes. Two people reading numbers at each other in the dark.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: alarmed, hand going to the valve
chars.pose: half up off his knees

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: instant, flat, no panic anywhere
chars.pose: not moving

panels.bg: the gauge, needle rising faster than it should, bare bulb
panels.action: 5:02am. It starts to run away from them.

panels.bg: the pressure gauge, needle sitting steady in the middle of the green band, no tremor in it

the logbook open flat on the crate, showing the second-of-January column in the small neat slanted hand — and laid on the page next to it, an old receipt covered in Itsuki's terrible handwriting, tonight's times and temperatures written down the back of it in the same order. The two columns run side by side. The numbers are the same numbers.
panels.action: Two columns, two hands, fifteen years apart, and they match all the way down. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: looking at the two columns, face doing absolutely nothing
chars.pose: crate, blanket, book on her knees

panels.bg: the boiler doorway, bare bulb below, flat screentone
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — standing in the bath doorway, small
chars.pose: blanket round her shoulders, holding the frame

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — beside her, filthy
chars.pose: standing

panels.bg: the bath hall at 5:52am, and rising off the flat surface of the water for the first time in three days: steam. The chipped Fuji mural behind it. Grey dawn in the high window.
panels.action: It is hot. Silent.

panels.bg: his phone screen, two unanswered messages, timestamped 4:12 and 5:31
panels.action: Somebody else did a night shift too.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grey with tiredness, reaching up
chars.pose: hanging the indigo noren on its hooks from outside

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu entrance at 6:01am, cold blue morning, the street starting to lighten, steam venting from the chimney above
panels.action: In seven chapters the reader has watched this curtain come down eleven times. This is the first time it has gone up.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: bag on his shoulder, ordinary
chars.pose: half-turned at the noren

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: at the counter, upright, wrecked
chars.pose: seated at the bandai

panels.bg: entrance, noren up, cold morning light coming in
panels.action: She has told him to come back every single time. Every time except this one.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, level, the counter voice
chars.pose: seated at the bandai, hands folded

panels.bg: the changing room at 6:04am, warm lamp still on against cold blue morning, steam rolling through the bath doorway, and an old man in a cap coming through the noren with a towel under his arm
panels.action: The first customer of the day. Nobody in the world knows what the water cost. Final panel.
